parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the base58, argparse, ESM, .mjs, zero-dependency, manual argv, and output-placement requirements, and embedded them in the workflow script.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It first performed direct exploratory probing, then launched a workflow with four parallel probe agents. The implementation owner existed but was placed strictly after all probe results were consolidated.
parallel.implementation: No Node port was written to /output. The first and retried implementation children were still inspecting the environment, source, and tracebacks when interrupted.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Because no implementation files were produced, there was no integration, assembly, or deliverable placement. Artifact validation found an empty artifact directory.
parallel.verification: The parent created a scratch oracle and collected probe results, and the workflow planned later differential fuzzing, but no implementation existed for integrated verification.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run closed at timeout with workflow status killed, no /output/test7.mjs, and official evaluation 0/141.

serial.requirements: The serial run worked from the same prompt and recognized the ESM, manual argv, base58, bytes repr, traceback, and artifact placement obligations.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent kept ownership of probing, implementation, testing, and fixes in a continuous local trajectory without child handoffs or workflow waits.
serial.implementation: It wrote /output/test7.mjs plus local ESM libraries for text, repr, errors, UTF-8, base conversion, base58, argparse, and linecache behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The generated files were present in the final artifact and artifact validation accepted the expected entry point and supporting libraries.
serial.verification: It ran sample checks, a 207-case differential suite across linecache scenarios with zero failures, and a 500-case fuzz run that exposed one remaining mismatch.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also timed out and failed the official solution, leaving at least one argv edge mismatch and passing 80/141 official samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the task requirements and encoded a detailed ground-truth and constraint set in the workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and progressively inferred the same required behavior by direct probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement recognition was not the main gap; parallel failed to convert known requirements into an artifact, while serial converted many of them into code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed the work into a probe phase, a single later implementer, then planned differential, fix, and audit stages.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing, coding, verification, and fixes in one uninterrupted owner path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel ownership deferred the only productive implementation owner until after probe aggregation, whereas serial moved directly from probing into writing modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel transmitted a very large consolidated probeSpec to the implementer and retried stalled probe keys without a visible reusable checkpoint.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept context in the same trajectory and applied discoveries directly in later edits and test reruns.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context crossed workflow boundaries in bulky or checkpoint-free form; serial preserved a continuous working context from observation to code change.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implementation children remained in exploration and traceback probing and did not write the required files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the entry point and eight supporting ESM modules, then edited modules after differential failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The serial path produced and revised concrete code; the parallel path never reached deliverable implementation before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Probe results returned into the workflow, but implementation was still in progress when the workflow was killed, so no usable implementation result existed to join.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial code changes stayed in the workspace and were immediately available for testing and final artifact capture.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child-result lifecycle pressure and no returned implementation; serial had no child join boundary and preserved its result in /output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel probes wrote scratch files outside /output and the implementers did not write any /output deliverable, so there were no write collisions but also no final tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created the expected /output tree with test7.mjs and local library modules, and artifact validation captured them.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's shared-state outcome was absence of deliverable state, not conflicting state; serial produced an integrated artifact tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned extensive differential and audit phases after implementation, but never reached them because there was no port to test.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran sample tests, reached 207/207 in its differential suite across linecache scenarios, then found a 499/500 fuzz result with one remaining mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had concrete pre-evaluator verification evidence; parallel verification stayed in pre-implementation probing and did not verify an integrated artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent the budget on direct probing, a separate parallel probe phase, stalled probe retries, and an implementation retry that was still active at shutdown.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also hit the global timeout, but only after writing files and running substantial tests and fixes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel budget pressure prevented any artifact; serial budget pressure left a partial but evaluable artifact and one known fuzz mismatch.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official records make this a both_fail pair, not a discordant pass/fail outcome. The material task-solving difference is the score gap and artifact availability: parallel delivered no /output/test7.mjs and scored 0/141, while serial delivered an artifact tree and passed 80/141 despite timing out with remaining defects.
parallel_contributors: Implementation was deferred behind a complete parallel probe phase.
Stalled probes were retried without visible reusable checkpoints.
The implementer received an oversized consolidated handoff and was still probing when the workflow was killed.
serial_contributors: One continuous trajectory wrote the ESM modules and entry point.
The same actor preserved findings through fixes and differential verification.
Artifact validation found test7.mjs and supporting libraries.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The serial implementation still had at least one observed argv-edge mismatch and failed the official evaluator, but it was concrete code rather than an empty artifact.
The parallel run had no submitted code defect to classify because no implementation was delivered.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator completed for both modes; the relation is based on current cell/status.json evaluation records.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors for the score gap; no discordant pass/fail outcome

candidates.reason: The workflow assigned a specific implementation child at line 255; the failure was delayed and unfinished implementation, not absence of an implementation owner.
There were no independently produced component implementations requiring reconciliation, and a single implementer was intended to own integrated code.

The workflow script owned the end-to-end sequence from probe to implementation, differential testing, fixes, and audit; the pipeline was blocked, not ownerless.
The blocking setup was not one mandatory preflight or oracle step; it was a separate multi-agent investigation phase, making Serial Investigation the better match.

The workflow ran overlapping investigation agents first and only delegated productive implementation after all probe results were consolidated, leaving the implementation phase deadline-constrained and unfinished.

candidates.near_match_reason: This was not a single mandatory preflight; multiple investigators ran as a first phase and collectively gated all implementation.

candidates.reason: The indispensable implementation path did start too late, but the directly evidenced boundary is the serial investigation gate and overloaded handoff, not a separate capacity allocation episode.
Probe fan-out and retries consumed budget, but the repeat-work part is captured by Checkpoint-Free Retry and the remaining timeout pressure is the same chain, not an independent label.
The implementer received a broad task, but the more specific failure was the bulky transferred probeSpec and unreduced context, which is retained as Bulk Handoff Overload.
Probe and implementer briefs included task, executable, environment, constraints, and output requirements; no already-known requirement was shown absent from the child brief.
The parallel workflow did not assign separate component implementations expected to interoperate, so no incompatible cross-agent interface contract materialized.
The evidence shows probe information was transferred into the implementer prompt rather than omitted or truncated; the problem was volume and reducibility.

The workflow packed up to sixty findings per probe plus notes into a consolidated spec and passed it to the implementer as an 80k-character prompt; the receiver restarted low-level exploration and never reduced the handoff into code.
candidates.realized_consequence: The implementer consumed the remaining window on repeated exploration from a bulky brief and wrote no deliverable files.
candidates.near_match_reason: The findings were present in the handoff; they were not proven lost, only too bulky and insufficiently reduced for the receiver.

candidates.realized_consequence: Repeated probe attempts consumed budget and shortened the implementation window before any deliverable could be written.
